title: Approve one bounded PPN baseline Docker audit — after reviewed installation
problem: The installed unattended profile blocks browser measurements. The synthetic Docker route passes acquisition, denial, containment, timeout and exact-authority proofs, but is inactive.
desired_effect: Record the exact scoped Decision answer and run exactly one preserved-baseline matrix after PR #873 is merged and its reviewed protected runtime is installed. Retain the Chromium-version non-comparability; do not complete release verification.
scope: PPN baseline 579878edd09f8274a2f5b9a9e8ac53e4dbc54769; four routes; 390×844 and 1440×900; one execution

does: Require merged PR #873, exact-head CodeRabbit approval and all CI jobs green; verify source, protected packaged runtime and loaded-consumer identities before authority writes
Approve only the pinned canonical Decision answer, publish only its canonical answer commit, install the exact protected one-shot Grant, submit one nonce-only request and retain its completed receipt
Recover only the same published approval or already-consumed receipt; refuse expiry, drift, dirty or divergent main, unrelated history and a different Grant
never_does: Merge PRs or reconcile Git, alter the installed network/credential profile, activate managed production, deploy or publish PPN, mutate PPN source or mark its release Action complete
Read real credentials into the container, expose the Docker socket, substitute a mutable image or arbitrary commands/URLs/roots/flags, reset a consumed Grant or dashboard lifecycle

success.effect: One baseline matrix has a host receipt; the one-shot action remains disabled with its durable receipt.
success.next: Review the actual reports and Chromium 149 versus historical Chrome 154 non-comparability. Resume arcadia go in a new session for separately governed final-release work.

failure.effect: No broader authority is installed. Approval publication failures retain the canonical commit; consumed Grants and host failure receipts remain preserved.
failure.next: Read the timestamped failure handoff. If code is not installed, operator-merge #873 then use the existing Recover Arcadia host services and protected transport action. Refresh an expired or changed scope through Arcadia; never reset or manually reconcile.
